title: A Room for Everything
blurb: Kitchen, Study, Greenhouse, Stable, Hall and more: each room gives something back.

steps.text: Make a Kitchen: a stove, a crafting table and a barrel.
steps.hint: Food made there is home-cooked and lasts half again as long.

steps.text: Make a Study: a lectern and six bookshelves.
steps.hint: A Study halves the paper your Blueprints cost.

steps.text: Make a Greenhouse: soil or planted pots under a glass roof.
Make a Stable: hay and a fence gate.
steps.hint: Your whistle reaches twice as far from home.

steps.text: Make a Hall: six seats and a table on a floor of 48 or more.
steps.hint: A meal eaten there feeds everyone in it.

steps.text: Make a Lookout: 12 or more up, with glass on three sides.
steps.hint: It reveals the land 256 blocks round home on the Atlas.

steps.text: Make a Bell tower: a bell, 8 or more above the ground outside.
steps.hint: It warns of a gate break two days ahead.

steps.text: Make a Workshop: any Precursor machine in a closed room.
steps.hint: Machines cost less essence to run there.
Your Hearth names what a room is missing: light, warmth, room, care or detail.
Grand is the top grade, and tier III needs one.

finish.line: Every room you build now gives you something.
